launch_server_context: use launch_server context manager to start a TCP or HTTP server on a free port and yield the port number
parse_server_port: parse a server start line string to extract the listening port number using regex
run_server_with_credentials: run a server executable with username, password, and host arguments via subprocess Popen
terminate_server_process: terminate a running server subprocess and print its remaining stdout output
check_server_exit_code: check if a server subprocess exited cleanly and raise RuntimeError if the return code is non-zero
